decisionContext: The owner explicitly approved both 24-row North Node source batches on 2026-09-05 and then authorized shipping the 48 approved North Node passages into the governed Calendar exact-aspect corpus by replying "yes please continue".
summary: A little more freedom may be enough to make an option you dismissed suddenly workable.
body: A little more freedom may be enough to make an option you dismissed suddenly workable. When Lilith sextiles the North Node, changing one rule, declining an expectation, asking for different terms, keeping more privacy, or admitting that you want something other people would not choose for you can make a previously awkward option fit much better. You do not need to turn the difference into a rebellion. Use the freedom on the condition that matters and see what becomes possible once approval is no longer doing all the deciding.
